scope: A0 P1 corrective repair 2C: explicit prepared effects, Arcane Strain lifecycle, and downstream navigation quality
changes: replaces recent WorldEvent-based prepared ability buffs with explicit PreparedAbilityEffect state
adds trigger, expiry, remaining-use, bonus and context scoping for successful preparations
makes Read Wind and Calibrated Sextant apply to and be consumed by exactly the next valid navigation-departure check
makes Precision Bore Sighting survive chance previews and be consumed by the first valid naval fire check
makes Personal Ward ignore non-dangerous exchanges, consume on the next dangerous boarding defense, and expire on world time
prevents repeated preparation uses from stacking duplicate active rows
persists departure navigation quality into VoyageState and applies it to real squall damage rather than weather occurrence
adds bounded Arcane Strain reliability penalties while keeping Arcane/Industrial interference as a separate cause
adds chunk-independent Arcane Strain recovery through the authoritative world clock for player and persistent NPC characters
makes attunement.arcaneStrain authoritative and condition.arcaneStrain a synchronized compatibility/display mirror
tightens Arcane Strain player-facing description to implemented behavior only
normalizes legacy v12 prepared-effect/strain state without a save-schema bump
adds additive normalized Supabase prepared_effects support

cohesion.world_time: prepared-effect expiry and Arcane Strain recovery use GameState.absoluteHour; no parallel timers are introduced
cohesion.world_events: ability-use events remain canonical history but no longer function as active-effect storage
cohesion.a0_1a_vessel_lifecycle: unchanged; prepared fire modifies only the firing check and cannot bypass terminal vessel/prize resolution
cohesion.a0_1b_npc_planner: Arcane recovery touches character state only and adds no scheduler events or planner mutations
cohesion.a0_1c_economy: unchanged; world-time recovery shares advanceWorld without directly changing stock, production, price or trade
cohesion.a0_2a_information: historical ability/world events remain available as information sources while active buffs live separately
cohesion.a0_2b_progression: ability practice retains the cadence engine; Deck Drill time naturally feeds strain recovery through advanceWorld
cohesion.navigation_weather: navigation quality changes hazard consequence only; weather occurrence remains owned by travel/weather logic
cohesion.combat: preview paths are read-only; only actual valid matching checks consume one-shot preparation
cohesion.expansion: no named port, culture or region branches; new routes/locations inherit the same world-time and navigation-quality mechanics
cohesion.presentation: accepted R1.2 geometry and art ownership unchanged

saveCompatibility: schema v12 unchanged; preparedEffects and voyage.navigationQuality are additive optional fields, legacy successful preparation events are converted at most once when explicit prepared state is absent, and Arcane Strain ownership is normalized on load
databaseCompatibility: migration 0011 adds prepared_effects jsonb to normalized character_capabilities; canonical cloud persistence remains the versioned game_saves.snapshot in this alpha
presentationChanged: no structural layout/art changes; only gameplay-truth wording and existing status consequences can differ
deferred: A0.3B character-build consequence and learning-source connection
